launches.title: 🇨🇦 Airwork - Canada's on-demand frontline workforce
launches.tagline: We connect Canadian businesses with the top 5% of general and skilled labourers within 2 hours
launches.body:
**tldr; Canada is facing a skilled labour shortage. Airwork is solving this by connecting businesses with the top 5% of general and skilled labourers on a flexible basis. Companies can fill any shift within 2 hours, and workers can work on their own terms. Check us out at **[**airwork.io**](http://airwork.io)**!**

Hey everyone, 👋

I’m [Gary](https://www.linkedin.com/in/garyjlin/), the founder of [Airwork](https://airwork.io). We’re a team of 5 building a marketplace to solve Canada’s labour shortage and give everyone the power to work on their own terms.

### **Problem: Canadian businesses are struggling with staffing**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/dbbd3422-576c-41db-aab8-2ae66e7c6bb0)

In Q4 of 2022, 36.9% of all Canadian businesses experienced difficulties hiring skilled labourers, led by construction (49.5%), manufacturing (47.4%), and food services (46.3%). We spoke to over 100 companies, and more than half have experienced one of these within the last 90 days:

👎 Candidate doesn’t show up to interview

👎 Candidate signs offer but doesn’t show up on the first day

👎 Employee quit without notice

👎 Employee consistently shows up late or leaves early

👎 Skilled labour positions go unfilled for months due to lack of applicants

### **🎉 Solution: Airwork 🎉**

Airwork is an on-demand labour marketplace that lets managers book vetted workers online within minutes. We spent the last year building in private beta and are now launching in **public beta**! 💪 🚀 📈

Airwork’s vetting process involves a resume screen, attendance test, background check, and video interview. As a result, out of tens of thousands of applicants, only the top 5% are selected.

We’re live the Greater Toronto Area, just expanded to all of Southern Ontario, and plan to expand across Canada.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/78a4a429-d2f2-4752-82b5-83f74d4e9656)

To date, Airworkers have filled skilled and general roles for:\
1\. Manufacturing plants\
2\. Warehouses and logistics companies\
3\. Construction companies\
4\. Events, conferences, and weddings\
5\. Commercial cleaning and facility services\
6\. Commercial printing

Workers can download Airwork on the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and apply to become an Airworker. Airworkers can book shifts nearby and get paid within the same day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/4fe06d68-03a9-44ec-b1d0-2a860ba9d9ff)

Our business portal also enables managers to create shifts, manage rosters, trigger backfills, and track time sheets all in one place. We also automate administrative and compliance complexities, reducing the overhead of workforce management:

✅ WSIB insurance coverage\
✅ RCMP-backed criminal record checks\
✅ Payroll and time-tracking\
✅ Automated backfilling

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73045&key=user_uploads/425576/8890f4bb-d0a4-41e8-9421-eb96fc0fbe05)

### **Do you need workers?**

Are you in Southern Ontario? Sign up for a free account at [airwork.io](http://airwork.io) and try us out! If not, reach out to [gary@airwork.io](mailto:gary@airwork.io) to join your city’s waitlist.

### **Do you know someone that might need workers?**

Send a referral to [gary@airwork.io](mailto:gary@airwork.io). Once your referee books 10 shifts on Airwork, we’ll give you a $1,000 CAD referral bonus! 💸

### **Do you want to take control of your work schedule?**

Download our app on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/airwork/id1644979123) or [Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.airwork.Llama) and get apply to become an Airworker today! 💪

launches.title: Nullstone: ☁️ Better dev experience for cloud providers
launches.tagline: We improve developer productivity with a better dev experience, modern automation workflows, and composable tooling.
launches.body:
### tl;dr

Nullstone improves developer team productivity with quality-of-life features that are difficult and costly to build with an in-house DevOps/Platform team: Auto-Build/Deploy, Preview Environments, GitOps, and Automatic Secrets Management.

### 🌩️ Problem

Launching and managing cloud apps is tedious and distracting for product teams. On average, building, maintaining, and orchestrating cloud infrastructure accounts for \~25% of a software team’s budget. The current solutions are inflexible, require significant expertise, and/or are costly:

* Platform-as-a-service (PaaS) are black boxes and don’t provide flexibility and control to achieve security, compliance, and reliability.
* Hiring DevOps Engineers to build custom infrastructure and automation is costly and distracting from a team’s primary purpose.
* Hiring Platform Engineers to build a custom, internal developer platform requires an enormous upfront build with a long-term maintenance cost of the platform that rarely provides an intuitive experience to developers.

The most precious resource for a software product are developers focused on building a fantastic product — a great developer experience is the [primary driver for productivity](https://queue.acm.org/detail.cfm?id=3595878).

### ☀️ Solution

Nullstone is a suite of tools delivered as a single product that enables developer self-service while accommodating the flexibility and control that platform engineers need to maintain secure, compliant, performant, and reliable infrastructure.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73668&key=user_uploads/850501/1fe8a18b-3ecb-48ab-8023-983d9f2f6826)

For developers, Nullstone provides an easy-to-use developer experience to deploy and observe apps on major cloud providers using containers, serverless, static sites, or servers.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73668&key=user_uploads/850501/99e0b94f-0672-4777-aa43-484f94961d06)

For platform engineers and architects, Nullstone provides a simple mechanism to provide modern delivery workflows and infrastructure building blocks to developers. Using familiar tools like Terraform ensures company policies are followed without needing to build a developer experience.

![uploaded image](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=73668&key=user_uploads/850501/53d30583-a275-4694-bd33-25b505012695)

### ⚙️ How it works

* Developers pick from an extensive, curated catalog of open-source, compliance-certified infrastructure modules or from company-built infrastructure modules.
* Developers choose to auto-build/deploy or use custom CI.
* Developers launch preview (ephemeral) environments from a pull request, through the UI, or through the API.
* Developers can use ClickOps or GitOps to control infrastructure.
* Developers can observe and monitor applications without accessing a cloud console.
* Platform Engineers build reusable infrastructure components for developers to self-serve through an easy-to-use UI.
* Platform teams customize networks, clusters, and datastores while providing the right level of access for developer self-service.
* Platform teams connect third-party log and metrics providers for developers.
* Platform Engineers perform automated rollouts of infra upgrades and bug fixes.

The flexibility allows Nullstone to support monoliths, monorepos, microservices, and everything in between.

### 🙏 Asks

* [Launch an app](https://app.nullstone.io/) for free!
* Want to learn more, [check us out](https://www.nullstone.io/) and [book a demo](https://www.nullstone.io/book-demo)!

long_description:
Think of us as your dedicated AI recruiting team, available 24/7 to engage with every single candidate in their preferred language. We help companies to evaluate 100% of their candidates while reducing the workload on their recruiting teams. 

Our technical co-founders, Rubén, Vladimir, and Sebastián, bring vast HR industry experience. HoyTrabajas is supported by Rebel Fund, Alan Rutledge, Kube Ventures, Flucas VC, Magic Fund, New Ventures, Y Combinator (w22), and more.
one_liner: AI solution that streamlines candidate screening and recruitment

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: The driving force behind HoyTrabajas comes from a personal fire that's also burning in my co-founders. We saw how the traditional job boards have been a real headache for job seekers, especially those who are just starting. I know this because I've been there myself, hunting for my first job and not getting any feedback on my applications. That made me crazy at that moment. Now picture what's going down for all those people who aren't chasing professional jobs. They're probably in a rush to put food on the table for their families. And you know what? This struggle is very real for around 100 million low-skilled individuals in LATAM. People are feeling the pain of job finding. That was our motivation to be over this bote.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: We applied four times. The first two attempts did not result in an interview. On our third attempt, we had an interview, but it did not go well. It was on our fourth attempt that we were selected.Our time at YC has been one of the most rewarding experiences of our lives. We learned about the immense value of focusing on the product. Besides, being part of a vast network, many U.S. funds now recognize us, making our fundraising journey less challenging.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: We visit Silicon Valley twice a year to meet investors and other YC startup founders. We arrange meetings at a specific location with some partners. Every three months, we also schedule an office hour to discuss business progress and challenges.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: * We launched in August 2019, beginning with five people: three founders and two employees.* We connected candidates and clients through WhatsApp.* In March 2020, we secured our first B2B customers.* We raised our pre-seed funding round of 500,000 USD.* We expanded operations to the three main cities in Colombia: Bogotá, Medellín, and Cali.* We established our first version of the Job Marketplace.* In November 2021, we became part of YCombinator.* We found PMF with one of our offerings in Colombia.* In 2022, we secured a seed funding round of 5 million USD.* In 2023, we expanded our business to Mexico.* We implemented AI tools to facilitate a better experience for candidates and clients.* In Q4 of 2023, we expanded our product offerings to provide more value to our customers and increase the average annual revenue.* Currently, we have 290 clients, with Mexico accounting for over 40% of our sales. We have a team of 64 people, 70% of whom work in product development.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: The Latin American job market faces challenges for both employers and job seekers, particularly in lower-skilled roles:1. **Limited Growth Opportunities:** Job seekers often find limited opportunities for skill development and career advancement, leading to professional stagnation.2. **Job Insecurity:** High turnover rates in low-skilled jobs result in job insecurity and financial instability.3. **Access to Quality Jobs:** With a hiring success rate often below 7%, job seekers struggle to find quality jobs that match their skills and preferences.4. **Lengthy Hiring Process:** An 8 to 10-day hiring process may delay employment, particularly for those urgently needing a job.5. **Career Development Support:** High turnover environments may lack training or support programs, impacting long-term employability.6. **Job Matching:** Mismatches between job seekers’ skills and employer requirements cause inefficiencies in hiring.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our goal is to become the leading platform in connecting low-skilled role-users with quality jobs, growth opportunities, and benefits. We are committed to transforming people's lives and making a positive impact on society while continually improving our services.

launches.body:
Mutable.ai is proud to introduce Auto Wiki, which lets you generate a Wiki-style website to document your codebase. Citations link to code, with clickable references to each line of code being discussed. Here are some examples of popular projects: \
\
React: <https://wiki.mutable.ai/facebook/react>\
Ollama: <https://wiki.mutable.ai/jmorganca/ollama>\
Kubernetes: <https://wiki.mutable.ai/kubernetes/kubernetes>\
D3: <https://wiki.mutable.ai/d3/d3>\
Bitcoin: <https://wiki.mutable.ai/bitcoin/bitcoin>\
Terraform: <https://wiki.mutable.ai/bitcoin/bitcoin>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77591&key=user_uploads/904867/af4c7637-aa61-4979-97ee-35370632ed8a)

Auto Wiki makes it easy to see at a high level what a codebase is doing and how the work is divided. In some cases, we’ve identified entire obsolete sections of codebases by seeing a section for code that was no longer important. Auto Wiki relies on our citations system which cuts back on hallucinations. The citations link to a precise reference or definition, meaning the wiki generation is grounded on the basis of the code being cited rather than free-form generation. 

[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HiP563Q9Sws])
\
We're running Auto Wiki on the most popular 1,000 repos on GitHub. If you want us to generate a wiki of a public repo for you, send us a note at [info@mutable.ai.](mailto:info@mutable.ai) The wikis take time to generate as we are still ramping up our capacity, but we’ll reply that we’ve launched the process and then come back with a link to your wiki when it’s ready. \
\
For private repos, you can use [wiki.mutable.ai](http://wiki.mutable.ai) to generate them simply by signing in, authorizing the repo, and paying for generation. We also offer private deployments with our model for enterprise customers; ping us at [info@mutable.ai](mailto:info@mutable.ai). \
\
Anyone who already has access to a repo through GitHub will be able to view the wiki, only the person generating the wikis needs to pay to create them. Pricing starts at $4 and ramps up by $2 increments depending on how large your repo is. In an upcoming version of Auto Wiki, we’ll include other sources of information relevant to your code and generate architectural diagrams. Please check out Auto Wiki and let us know your thoughts! Thank you!

launches.title: Bracket - Sync Salesforce & Postgres: Heroku Connect alternative for any SaaS
launches.tagline: Two way syncs between business tools and your database
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** [**Bracket**](https://app.usebracket.com) syncs data bidirectionally between tools like Salesforce & databases like Postgres — think Heroku Connect between any SaaS tool and any database or warehouse. For companies that collect customer-relevant information in SaaS tools, Bracket is the simplest way for engineers to get this data in front of customers in real time.

—

Hey everyone! We’re Vinesh, Ian, and Kunal and we’re building Bracket.

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/xrZwklibKE9wZuf_lyCSiei3Nt082k0IncnOuMZsmtUqwLV_JLbWEPilfCw1HJ41-GfqJg7XruoZP4cigIcN3RfnS7vKItZsqlzx8uyAMRBJs1dQItNfvU8E8f9I7qWzJZZHT1NhxwblRHAdUajPh4s)

### **The problem**

Companies often need a way to manually adjust the info that a lead or customer sees - think of the sales team of a software company that wants to customize a demo environment for a high-value lead, or the ops team of a car rental company that needs to manage which cars are available for customers to book. 

The job of designing, implementing, and championing a fix falls to engineering. Engineers can either build a custom UI for their teammates, or connect with the tools they already use, like Salesforce or Airtable. 

There are a few problems with this:

1. Custom UIs run against the grain of the tools that business teams already use and can even require double data entry on the part of those teams. This leads to low adoption. 
2. This leads most engineers to integrate with their business teams’ existing tools. However, setting up real-time two-way syncs is a highly technical challenge that can take entire quarters of implementation time.

In short, custom-built solutions lead to low adoption, and built-from-scratch integrations with business teams’ tools can take months of engineering effort.

### **How we solve it**

**Using two-way syncs, Bracket is the easiest way to keep data in sync between business teams’ existing tools, like Salesforce, and databases, like Postgres.** 

This creates a win-win-win. Using the Salesforce <> Postgres example:

* Engineering gets to build on top of Postgres and doesn’t have to deal with the Salesforce API (we do that for you). Engineering also meets business teams where they are, optimizing adoption.
* Customer-facing business teams (e.g. Sales, CX) continue to leverage Salesforce, a familiar, highly productive tool with tons of features and a strong community, and can trust that their data is fresh.
* Customers - seeing fresh, personalized data - get the best UX possible, increasing lead conversion and paid retention.

 

Our new web app works with Salesforce and Postgres along with other connectors (like  Airtable, Google Sheets, MySQL and more).

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/plJHt6uWnEfHvqApcTBso-yoZ9penLWsS7gyG4usf8avqWinfSaNtFVRLwV4Hd7eFAcmJ-A-ueNFIgpiv33S4TlCZGBd_OyOzauJWPKPKRj3r_-PSyKQMxoqJqQ5T03cd7LPWWLlg_9DJ0marOEavuM)

### **Demo:**

[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sRkaAa667T0)

### **Differences from Heroku Connect?**

1. **Built for your tech stack:** We support beyond just Heroku Postgres. Not only do we support any hosted Postgres, but we also have two-way syncs with other databases and warehouses.
2. **Active Development:** Heroku Connect hasn’t been updated in years and has no new features on their official roadmap. Bracket continues to develop around the modern stack.
3. **Uses cases across teams:** We’ve built two-way syncs for CRMs like Salesforce but also other products like Airtable, Google Sheets, and more.
4. **Price:** We’re far cheaper than Heroku Connect, which can run north of $50k / year.

### **Our ask:**

If you want to try this yourself, get started[ **here**](https://app.usebracket.com)

Otherwise, if you:

1. Are looking for two-way syncs between other tools and want us to build it
2. Know any data engineers at mid-market / enterprise companies to make an intro
3. Have any other questions, please reach out to [founders@usebracket.com](mailto:founders@usebracket.com)

launches.title: Vessel: Easily integrate with your customer’s CRM
launches.tagline: Vessel allows developers to read and write to their customer’s CRM with one integration.
launches.body:
### ⁉️ Problem

For products that need access to their customer’s CRM, having a breadth of integrations has become table-stakes. However, it is difficult to build CRM integrations in-house, because you need to:

* support different types of authentication
* understand the data model, APIs, and ever-changing specs of each CRM platform
* handle platform limitations like API quotas and limited webhooks support
* transform data from your customer’s CRM for use in your product

Companies are spending a lot of engineering resources building and maintaining CRM integrations in-house. For instance, we spoke to a company that built a HubSpot integration and had to turn it off because they didn’t have the resources to handle HubSpot’s API limits.

### 💡 Solution

Vessel is the universal API for CRMs, making it easy for developers to build applications that integrate with their customer’s CRM.

* A unified interface to read and write across 8 objects: Accounts, Leads, Contacts, Deals, Events, Notes, Tasks, [Users](https://vesseldocs.stoplight.io/docs/vessel/603bd0ce2abb1-get-all-users)
* [Webhooks](https://vesseldocs.stoplight.io/docs/vessel/e1m6clym4s5ya-webhooks) to keep your data fresh without polling even if the end platform does not offer webhooks on certain objects.
* A drop-in UI to securely connect your customer’s CRM to your product
* Avoidance of rate limits for platforms you integrate with
* Improved developer experience with strongly associated objects. You can easily identify all of the associated objects (e.g. going from leads -> accounts, accounts -> leads)

### ⚡ Get started

If you’re looking to integrate CRMs into your product, book some time [here](https://calendly.com/vesselapi/vessel-demo) or send us an email with your use case at [founders@vessel.land](mailto:founders@vessel.land)! Learn more at <https://vessel.land>.

launches.title: Nophin - Cresa, AI Analyst for CRE Deal Screening
launches.tagline: Cresa is like having an analyst who quickly filters out deals that don’t fit your criteria and speeds up due diligence on the ones that do.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr**\
Today, to screen a multifamily deal, acquisition teams manually import rent rolls and operating statements and conduct market research for comps before running assumptions to see if a deal fits their criteria; Cresa automates the entire process. Cresa is a fine-tuned multimodal Agent that handles key workflows for acquisition teams 24/7 so they can focus on high-potential investments. Cresa can screen deals using your preferred acquisition model, analyze deal documents, conduct market research, and generate comprehensive reports. Try Cresa’s [Rent Comp Research](https://cresa.nophin.com/) — no signup or prior experience is needed.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vPVEDKdekU&ab_channel=NophinAI>

**Team**\
We're Kwadwo and Weeks, a technical team of second-time YC founders and CRE investors on a mission to revolutionize commercial real estate investing. Having experienced the inefficiencies in CRE investing firsthand, we previously built an end-to-end underwriting solution. There, we uncovered a major pain point for investors: the top-of-the-funnel bottleneck of screening deals, where they waste time reviewing countless deals that don’t match their buying criteria.

**Problem**\
Acquisition teams are bogged down by the manual tasks required to screen deals, from analyzing deal documents to conducting time-consuming comp research before testing assumptions in an Excel model. A thorough diligence process takes an average of two hours. The workflow is highly manual, yet each deal is unique, preventing easily scaled processes. These inefficiencies lead to missed opportunities and slowed decision-making, making it difficult to focus on high-potential opportunities.

**Solution**

Cresa is an AI Screening Analyst that automates multifamily deal screening and diligence processes. Cresa is the first fine-tuned multimodal CRE Agent that handles key workflows for acquisition teams 24/7 so they can focus on high-potential opportunities. Cresa can screen deals using your preferred acquisition model, analyze documents, conduct market research, generate comprehensive reports, and send emails.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84018&key=user_uploads/289172/1b4daad8-fe9f-4816-a301-4e41f11994ed)

**Cresa In Action**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qR4CZ4x0iVk&ab_channel=NophinAI>

**Key Highlights**

1. Specify your investment criteria, and Cresa will automatically screen and filter deals using your acquisition model — each time.
2. Cresa can analyze and summarize deal documents like rent rolls, T-12s, OMs, and more and answer complex questions.
3. Sync real-time data to your acquisition models and download the analysis in Excel.
4. Run dynamic scenarios within your acquisition model.
5. Ask Cresa to conduct real-time market research from web sources and email you or anyone on your team a comprehensive summary.
6. Cresa can help generate investment memos using analyzed financials and market research, summarizing key takeaways for stakeholders.

**Our Ask**

* Connect us to acquisition teams focused on multifamily assets.
* Try Cresa’s [Rent Comp Research](https://cresa.nophin.com/) — No prior experience is needed. Please give us feedback at [founders@nophin.com](mailto:founders@nophin.com)
* Follow us and share this post on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nophin/) and  [X](https://x.com/NophinInc).

launches.title: User Insights by PropelAuth: Don’t just acquire your users - understand them
launches.tagline: PropelAuth makes it easy for B2B companies to start onboarding users quickly
launches.body:
Hi all! We’re the team at PropelAuth and we’re really excited today to launch User Insights!

### What is PropelAuth?

[PropelAuth](https://www.propelauth.com/?utm_source=launchyc) makes it easy for B2B companies to start onboarding users quickly. A [simple integration](https://docs.propelauth.com/getting-started/quickstart-fe) gets you everything you need, from signup and login pages to 2FA to invitation flows to Enterprise SSO.

In addition to that (as you’ll see in this launch), our goal is to also help you grow your business. We understand that building a product/company is incredibly challenging and we want to take as much off your plate as possible.

.

### What problem is User Insights solving?

When we first started out a few years ago, all of our customers were other early stage startups.

As an early stage startup, the first thing you want to do is just get your product live immediately - get your MVP in front of users, get feedback, and hear if you are headed in the right direction or not.

Our role there is pretty straightforward - we need to provide the simplest authentication story possible to help our customers get in front of their users.

However, as our customers have grown in both number of MAUs and headcount, we’ve realized that they all tend to shift from “the most important thing is getting in front of people” to “how can we pour fuel on this fire?”

Put differently, it’s not enough to simply get users signed up - you need to know more about them.

.

### What is User Insights?

With User Insights by PropelAuth, you can quickly get an understanding of:

* Who your power users are
* Which users and organizations are at risk for churn
* Where your users are coming from
* Which of your organizations are growing

.

### 💪 Identifying Power Users

Forming relationships with your power users is key to growth. They’re potential advocates, potential logos for your marketing site, and will likely have the best feedback for you about your product experience. Plus… they’re the most willing to pay if they’re not already!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/dc0abe3f-a561-4f33-9e50-aae735e8698b)

If you’re curious about an individual users usage, we also provide a visualization on their user page, like this user who clearly is a big fan:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/fd4cd0e9-606d-4347-ae5a-3db7277cdc90)

Or this user… who you might want to check in with:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/73f6b3fa-144f-4936-91b5-d75a2d90ea15)

.

### ⚠️ Proactively identifying Churn Risk

Speaking of proactively checking in with customers, we wanted to make that easier as well.

While it’s exciting to see your user count go up, that’s not the end of the work you have to do: you also have to make sure to retain as many of those users as possible.

With our Churn reports, you can easily see which of your users and organizations haven’t been active in your product for awhile:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/a61c595f-f9ed-4e7e-ab71-0d7fe00d1cd9)

We also provide re-engagement reports so you can see how your efforts are going to get these users back into your product.

.

### 🔍 Understanding where users came from

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/04f77928-72fa-42eb-a877-d66af61e2821)

Understanding where your users are coming from is the easiest way to make sure your marketing efforts aren’t going to waste. Now, any URL query parameters that users have on sign up will be stored. You’ll be able to get both an aggregate report (see above) or take a look at a specific user’s profile page:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/3fcb54a2-6c4d-4a72-a7bc-6ba6afb2a3d6)

.

### 📈 See how quickly your customers are expanding

One of the most exciting moments for any B2B company is watching one of your customers onboard more employees to your product.

And keeping an eye on which of your organizations are growing quickly can make it easy to target efforts around upselling. The Organization Growth report lets you see that at a glance:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/1f730d81-6c2c-40d8-83b5-5288eda8a207)

You can also quickly see which of your users is responsible for growth with the Top Inviters report. We recommend keeping in touch with these users - they’re your biggest advocates!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77445&key=user_uploads/609048/a86b1605-0100-43f4-b58b-5c58479162aa)

.

### And more…

There are also more reports to discover, charts to visualize how you are doing, and stats to see how this month compares to previous months. We’re also working on a few integrations so you can sync this data to your own analytics platform for even deeper analysis.

.

### Our asks

* Ready to set up your B2B auth flow and gain a better understanding of your users? [Sign up for PropelAuth here.](https://www.propelauth.com/?utm_source=launchyc)
* Want to keep up to date with our product updates? Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/propelauth) or [Twitter](https://twitter.com/PropelAuth)!
* Have an idea/request for something that you didn’t see above? Send us an email at [support@propelauth.com](mailto:support@propelauth.com)

Thanks,

The PropelAuth Team

name: Fogbender
long_description:
Fogbender helps B2B companies support customer teams: think Intercom meets Slack's shared channels.

Today, all customer software is explicitly or implicitly designed for helping individuals, not teams. This is forcing B2B companies - who sell products to teams, not individuals - to augment their default customer support platform (Zendesk, Intercom, Front, etc) with a second, "unofficial", system: Slack's shared channels.

This causes a number of operational and logistical difficulties for both vendors and their customers, resulting in added costs, inefficiencies, and lost opportunities.

With Fogbender, B2B vendors embed a team-to-team messaging widget directly on their customer dashboard, where all users belonging to an account can - with no additional authentication - 1) see a list of currently-open issues 2) participate in conversations with their own team and the vendor, and 3) search all historical discussions.

long_description:
Soteri Skin is D2C skincare for chronic skin conditions like eczema. We’re the only non-prescription product proven to provide long-lasting relief for the 30 million Americans who suffer from eczema.

How it works:
Skin surface pH is constantly in flux, and many of your daily activities can throw it out of balance. People with chronic skin conditions such as eczema have a harder time regulating their skin's pH. 

Soteri's patented pH/LOCK™ locks skin in at a therapeutic pH for 12+ hours, which is shown to help break the cycle of skin sensitivity, whether you have eczema, psoriasis, or just a bad sunburn.

Our formulations are aesthetically elegant (non-sticky, sit well under makeup, etc), safe for anyone to use, and don't require a prescription. Most people see skin health improvements within the first few weeks of application, even for tricky, chronic skin conditions like eczema and psoriasis.

With Soteri Skin, anyone can enjoy healthy, glowing, pH-enomenal skin!
one_liner: D2C Skincare for Eczema

launches.title: ShapedQL: The SQL engine for search, feeds, and AI agents
launches.tagline: Connect your data. Train your models. Query text, user or session context and retrieve relevant results in milliseconds.
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋\
\
I'm Tullie, the founder of [Shaped](https://www.shaped.ai/).\
\
**TL;DR**\
\
Today we’re launching ShapedQL, a new language purpose built for agents, feeds and search. We built ShapedQL because we realized that while retrieval has become easier (thanks to Vector DBs), ranking and relevance are still incredibly hard.\
\
Launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Owj_uSUPNaU>\
\
**Problem ❌**\
\
Most engineering teams we talk to are stuck maintaining a "Frankenstein" stack. To build a "For You" feed or give an AI Agent personalized memory, they have to glue together a vector database, a feature store (like Redis), a reranking service, and thousands of lines of Python spaghetti code.\
\
**Solution ✅**\
\
We built ShapedQL to turn that "house of cards" into a single interface.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97225&key=user_uploads/812951/eed67b43-7c3b-4b0f-819a-5bbd31db2732)

ShapedQL is a domain-specific SQL dialect that compiles down to a high-performance, multi-stage ranking pipeline. With a single query, you can define the four stages of modern relevance:\
**1. Retrieve:** Fetch candidates from multiple sources (Hybrid Search, Collaborative Filtering, Trending).\
**2. Filter:** Apply hard constraints (e.g., "in stock" or "within 50 miles").\
**3. Score:** Rank results using real-time ML models (optimizing for clicks, purchases, or watch time).\
**4. Reorder:** Enforce diversity so your users (or Agents) don't see the same 5 items repeatedly.

We're seeing teams reduce 2,000+ lines of maintenance code down to \~30 lines of ShapedQL, while shipping features like "Cart Upsell" or "Conversational Recommendations" in days instead of months.

If you're not a fan of SQL we also have Python or Typescript SDKs, perfect for a real-time production integration.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97225&key=user_uploads/812951/d3cc12cc-3c74-448b-adf0-ae65d9359b79)

**Ask 💬**\
\
**1.** We have a Product Hunt launch at this link: <https://www.producthunt.com/products/shaped>. Any support or and upvote would be greatly appreciated!\
\
**2.** Please try out our interactive demo at [playground.shaped.ai](https://playground.shaped.ai), we’d love to hear any feedback on the new language. Were you able to easily make a query? Do the docs make sense? What is it missing?\
\
**3.** If the problems above resonates and you’re struggling to get true relevance from your vector store or current retrieval system, please get in touch! Book on this calendar here: <https://www.shaped.ai/contact> and mention you’re from YC. I’ll make sure to jump on the call to help you out myself.

launches.tagline: A control panel for your business objectives
launches.body:
# **TL;DR**

We’ve built Shaped Value Modeling, a framework that enables real-time optimization of recommendation and search ranking models for multiple objectives. It allows teams to blend different objectives (e.g. relevance, conversions, diversity) and dynamically run AB tests that drive business outcomes (with built in analytics tooling). Our community has seen awesome results, so we’re excited to bring this framework to the masses!

Watch our demo [here](https://youtu.be/gYLmtMR-N4I).

**Key Features:**

* **Multi-objective optimization:** Combine multiple models and signals (e.g., click prediction, purchase likelihood, content quality) into a single, customizable scoring function.
* **Dynamic ranking logic:** Define and adjust ranking objectives as your business needs change using a simple python DSL.
* **Real-time API:** Modify ranking scores on the fly with simple API calls, enabling rapid experimentation and A/B testing.
* **Easy to integrate:** Connect and deploy rapidly with direct integration to your existing data sources.
* **Explainability:** Gain insights into why certain items rank higher through interpretable scoring logic, and a built in analytics platform out of the box.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88281&key=user_uploads/857360/543b423e-521a-491d-808b-0bd914f06c23)

**Why This Matters:**

* Rapid iteration: Experiment with new ranking strategies and adapt to changing business needs without lengthy retraining cycles.
* Improved control: Fine-tune your ranking algorithms with precision and transparency.
* Better alignment: Optimize for multiple KPIs simultaneously, ensuring your recommendations drive both engagement and business value.

**How it Works:**

1.Train separate models for different objectives (e.g., LightGBM for click prediction, BERT4Rec for purchase likelihood).

2\. Define a "value model" that combines these models using mathematical expressions and custom logic. Let's say we have a lightgbm click-through-rate model called ctr_model and a transformerd based next purchase model called purchase_model, you can create an ensembled value model as follows:

```
value_model = 0.5 * ctr_model + 0.5 * purchase_model + log(item.quality_score)
```

3\. Dynamically adjust the value_model via API calls to optimize for different goals or user segments:

```
{
  "user_id": "83NSLX",
  "config": {
    "value_model": "0.3 * ctr_model + 0.7 * purchase_model"
  }
}
```

\
How our customers are using value modeling:

* **Marketplaces:** Dynamically mix personalized scores with a geo-location penalizer to connect users with nearby items.
* **E-commerce:** Balance purchase intent, engagement, and product quality.
* **Content platforms:** Implement time-decay, boost high-quality content, and personalize recommendations.
* **Social media:** Dynamically switch between personalized and trending models.

# **Our ask**

If you know decision-makers in any of these types of organisations, we’d be super grateful for an introduction at [daniel@shaped.ai](mailto:daniel@shaped.ai)

1. Marketplaces
2. E-commerce
3. Content platforms
4. Social Media

For more information see our website [here](https://www.shaped.ai/value-modelling) and developer docs [here](https://docs.shaped.ai/docs/model_creation_guides/value-modeling)

[Get a demo](https://meetings.hubspot.com/matt2900/meet-with-shaped-?uuid=4076ed73-5725-4ee7-ac01-2e1869237a18) if you’re interested in testing value modeling!

launches.title: Ploomber: Heroku for AI
launches.tagline: A platform to deploy AI and data applications quickly
launches.body:
**tl;dr; **[**Ploomber**](https://www.platform.ploomber.io/register)** is a cloud platform that quickly deploys container-based AI and data applications (Streamlit, Shiny, Panel, Flask, FastAPI, etc.)**\
—

Hey all! We're [Eduardo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edublancas) and [Ido](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ido-michael) from Ploomber, and we're excited to launch our cloud platform!

**Problem**

With the rise of AI and data, many companies are deploying applications whose requirements differ from typical web applications. The most common differences are larger computational resources and libraries that many PaaS platforms do not allow to install (case in point: one of our customers migrated to our platform after several failed attempts to install a C++ library required for their Python app to run). These restrictions hinder the ability of many companies to ship complex AI and data applications.

**Our Solution**

Our container-based platform provides greater flexibility when deploying applications: you can quickly provision more resources and install anything your app requires to run.

We provide official support for frameworks like Streamlit, Shiny, Panel, Flask, and FastAPI, but you can use any framework you want.

We also provide a feature that stops your application automatically if it doesn't receive traffic and starts it again on an incoming request; this offers significant savings for many of our customers who deploy low-traffic applications.

**How it works**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78826&key=user_uploads/564961/8070baa6-6dc5-468e-8041-cb35cf860f53)

You can deploy applications with the UI or via the command-line interface (you can also use the CLI to deploy on each commit to your git repository).

**Live examples**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78826&key=user_uploads/564961/50219f4a-395d-4d0d-98cb-4e123ad50efa)

[Arxiv Chat:](https://summer-wind-5194.ploomberapp.io/) a chatbot that allows you to search, ask questions, and download papers from Arxiv. 

[Analytical dashboard](https://broad-fire-8217.ploomberapp.io) built with Panel.

[Flask app](https://wild-bonus-9050.ploomberapp.io/) with user authentication and API key management.

**Try it out!**

[Create an account](https://www.platform.ploomber.io/register) and check our [documentation](https://docs.cloud.ploomber.io/en/latest/intro.html) to get started!

**We can help you migrate!**

If you already deployed an application, we can help you migrate at no cost! Please email us at [contact@ploomber.io](mailto:contact@ploomber.io)! We also have discounts for the YC community, so contact us!

launches.title: Arpari – Multibank treasury management
launches.tagline: One login for multibank finance teams
launches.body:
# [**👋**](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand) Hi YC,

I’m Alex, founder of [Arpari](https://www.arpari.com/). Over the past 3 years, we’ve been working with commercial real estate finance teams to streamline their bank account data. We’ve built a multibank dashboard to provide a single login to teams working with hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks. 

💸 Today we’ve launched **multibank payments**, further reducing the need for teams to log into separate bank portals. Now, teams can fully manage their account inventory, reconcile transactions, and make transfers in a single dashboard.  

🚀 Recently, we have **expanded our focus beyond** real estate to satisfy all entity structures. Whether you are a small finance team with a simple account structure or you deal with hundreds of subsidiaries and entities and the complexity that brings, Arpari makes it easy to streamline your bank-related processes. 

# **TL;DR**

* Arpari centralizes account inventory, balances, and transactions across all your accounts, making month-end processes a breeze
* Our dashboard works with any number of banks and complex entity structures 
* Today, we launched payments so your team just needs to log into a single portal to set up and approve all payments to vendors, investors and anyone else
* Do you know any finance teams that work with more than one bank? Please introduce us! Email [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com) or [book a demo here](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo)

  

# **❌ The Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/57361321-c472-4677-955d-e6feecc21f04)

Finance teams who are responsible for balance reporting and transaction reconciliation often scramble at month end, don’t report at the frequency they’d like, or sacrifice reporting accuracy altogether.   

1. **ACCOUNT INVENTORY**: Using multiple banks can mean liquidity is an unknown, especially for teams who work with many accounts. Bank accounts tracked in Excel—many unnamed or vaguely labeled—makes effective management nearly impossible. Often accounts are missed, and cash misplaced. 
2. **MANAGING ACCESS**: Financial operations are severely hindered by fragmented bank access scattered across multiple team members. Accountants regularly need separate logins, deal with constant lockouts, and navigate multiple security code requests, reducing productivity. Add in payment approval workflows, and you have duplicate, complex permissions to manage across multiple portals. 
3. **DATA NORMALIZATION**: Beyond data access, when teams finally gather transaction data across banks, the data comes through in various formats. Many banks only offer PDF downloads, some banks don’t even provide export.  
4. **TRANSFER MONITORING**: Teams need to log into multiple portals to monitor pending transactions and approvals. Additionally, when vendor or investor bank details change, they need to update the information across multiple portals.

 

Teams who have tried to solve this problem have found treasury software that doesn’t work for multibank users. Incumbent solutions price with bank-by-bank implementation, which doesn’t work for users who have hundreds of accounts across 10+ banks, with their account and bank list constantly in flux. 

  

# 👩‍💻  **Our Solution: One login for all finance teams needs**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/7bf3d96a-04c3-4687-b9a6-6d369a929170)

  

We’ve built a dashboard for finance teams to interact in one place. When teams are doing the same manual tasks 10+ times, why not do them once? 

### STABLE CONNECTIONS

We leverage various connection methods to banks to provide stable, usable data daily to our customers. The account, balance, and activity information is the foundation to all workflows for our customers; unifying this information into a single place gives them back time for month-end reporting, peace of mind, and full transparency of their true cash flow.  

### DASHBOARD CUSTOMIZATION

We offer added customization to help organize account, balance, and activity data. Our dashboard is built around teams with complex fund and entity structures and prioritizes easy navigation according to how our users think about their bank information. 

### SINGLE PORTAL ACCESS

With payment approval workflows and read-only access, finance teams no longer need to permission non-account signers into bank portals. Finance teams can conduct their day-to-day operations without needing to log into 10+ portals to make payments or pull activity. 

  

Whether you are the controller sending investor distributions and paying vendors, an executive who wants a headline snapshot of cash, or an accountant reconciling transactions, Arpari saves you time. 

  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89175&key=user_uploads/859217/a04f6c1b-0560-4b46-88f3-006cef73f664)

# **🙏  Ask**

* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/arpari/), and [book a demo](https://www.arpari.com/book-demo) with our team. 
* **Share this post!** -  Do you know anyone in your network who is a CFO, controller, account manager, or treasurer? Please share this post! 
* Learn more at [arpari.com](http://arpari.com)

 

👉 Contact me at [Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com](mailto:Alexandra.zwiener@arpari.com)

launches.title: Workflow86: AI that automates any workflow/business process in minutes
launches.tagline: Automate any workflow/business process by describing it in natural language
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Workflow86 is an AI workflow engineer that takes natural language descriptions of business processes and automatically creates fully configured automations with forms, tasks, AI, integrations, and more. 

https://www.loom.com/share/87e8ea3ad34b425dab8bdfaf31da7f1c?sid=27762eb9-43d8-44a5-8daf-5a1d6ce4e51f

# **The Problem**

Every business has mission-critical processes that eat up hours of manual work: employee onboarding, contract approvals, lead qualification, vendor management. You know automation could help, but it faces three major issues:

1. **Existing business systems are rigid,** and systems of record like CRMs and ERPs make customization frustrating, complex, and expensive, often requiring external consultants or their own dedicated developers 
2. **No-code tools still have a significant learning curve,** and teams still spend weeks figuring out how to configure and build custom workflows properly before they can deliver value
3. **Pure no-code solutions struggle to handle edge cases** or highly custom business logic, requiring complex and clunky workarounds.
4. **Existing tools struggle to fully capture real-world business processes,** which involve complex processes that require a mixture of automation and human-in-the-loop, involve multiple teams and stakeholders, and extend across days, weeks, or even months.

   

## **Our Solution**

Workflow86 is an AI workflow engineer that takes natural language descriptions of business processes and automatically creates fully configured automations with forms, tasks, AI steps, integrations, and more. 

### **Design and deploy automations in minutes**

This allows anyone to build and deploy custom business processes and workflow automations by chatting to their own on-demand workflow automation expert. 

1. **Describe your process** in natural language or even upload an image, flowchart, or process diagram
2. **AI asks clarifying questions** and develops an implementation plan just like a business analyst would
3. **AI builds and implements everything** using a combination of forms, human-in-the-loop tasks, database queries, AI steps, API integrations, and even custom JavaScript/Python code
4. **Deploy immediately** or iterate. You can manually edit the workflow yourself or with more AI assistance

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/594b669e-574d-4954-a739-3b809de40c01)

### **Combining the best of code and no-code, AI and human-in-the-loop**

Workflow86 goes beyond just connecting different apps together and builds end-to-end workflows with a range of nodes designed to handle the most complex real-workflow business processes and use cases. 

**Visually model complex business processes** and workflows end-to-end in one place via an intuitive visual flow interface with notes, descriptions, and AI explanations to keep everything up-to-date and easy to understand. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/86e66142-9d21-49b4-be71-e8fc1475c132)

**Run custom code** nodes to provide the power and flexibility of code to handle edge cases and complex, or highly customized steps. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/410c36be-1f4a-4668-aced-8181193ca9a8)

**Create AI-powered workflows** with AI nodes that use the latest LLMs to perform tasks inside of their workflow, including summarizing content, extracting values, searching the web, and more. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/ecf9b065-7f6a-4a7e-87b1-63eab31c1875)

**Built-in forms and human-in-the-loop** tasks keep everything in check for workflows requiring human review, approvals, and more. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/54f85e87-704b-4b49-bfda-3c58bb26755d)

**Integration nodes to seamlessly connect** to your existing systems and apps, allowing workflows to be triggered from your existing systems and apps (like your CRM, ticketing, email, and HR systems), and to trigger actions and events in these apps as well. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91547&key=user_uploads/854439/755a1ce8-00c1-48e4-8881-a1f8fd60ef62)

### Use cases and examples

Here are some real-world examples you can try:

> Create an employee onboarding workflow that sends welcome emails, creates IT tickets for equipment, schedules meetings with the team, and tracks completion of training modules

> Build a contract approval process that routes based on contract value, requires legal review for contracts over $50k, collects digital signatures, and notifies stakeholders

> I need a lead scoring system that enriches leads from our website, scores them based on company size and engagement, assigns to sales reps by territory, and creates follow-up tasks

> Set up a customer refund process that validates the order, checks refund eligibility, gets manager approval for amounts over $500, processes the refund, and updates our CRM

> Create an expense approval workflow where employees submit receipts, AI categorizes expenses, routes to managers based on amount, and syncs approved expenses to QuickBooks

## Try it today

Visit[ workflow86.com](http://workflow86.com) to start for free. Type in a workflow or business process you want to automate and click generate to see our AI in action.

Have a complex workflow in mind? Book a demo and we'll build it with you live.

launches.title: Kenobi - Personalize your website to every visitor
launches.tagline: Each web visitor is different. Let your site speak uniquely to each one.
launches.body:
Hi all, we are [Chris](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrismjelde/) and [Rory](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rorz/), founders of [Kenobi](https://kenobi.ai).

**TL;DR:** _Kenobi is a small widget that asks your website visitors what company they’re from. For those that opt in, the whole page changes in about 3 seconds, making the page hyper-relevant to them._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/12072fa5-f903-4e42-88b2-5505250f9c5b)

### Problem

98% of web traffic does _not_ convert.

That’s because your website looks the same to everyone: a startup founder and the CFO of a Fortune 500 company get the exact same experience when they land on your site. When you have to speak to everyone, you end up speaking to no-one.

### Solution: Kenobi

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/a085a931-7365-4611-ac7e-e9f801324423)

Kenobi appears on your website as a small widget (we call it a ‘cue card’), prompting site visitors to share what company they’re from.

When a cue card is submitted, our agent collects context on the visitor, marries it up against the deep research its done on the host domain, and swaps the content on the page to make it hyper-personalized and unique, all in 2-3 seconds.

### The value

The value of Kenobi is two-fold:

1. Web visitors that opt-in for a personalized experience engage **3x longer** and convert **2x better** than the average visitor
2. All cue card submissions are sent to you in Slack (much like a deanonymization tool like RB2B, or Vector), so that you can enrich the leads and outbound them

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/3e972baa-67ec-40bb-9dbd-51044fa7a551)

### Demo video

https://www.loom.com/share/d3145c167cb84172a6dc242ef8e93109

### How we got here

We were building Verdn, a donation software, for 4+ years. We pivoted into building Kenobi in May, and for the last few months we’ve been working with sales teams to generate customized landing pages for outbound campaigns.

During all that time, our #1 feature request has been to cater for inbound web traffic. After tens of thousands of web page variations, we feel like our model is finally good and fast enough to tackle _inbound_ personalization.

### Try it

Go to [kenobi.ai/start](http://kenobi.ai/start) and see in 30 seconds how YOUR page can be personalized to any visitor. If you like how it looks, sign up for our free plan, no CC required.

2) Modular EV architecture that enables rapid, cost-efficient production.

Olympian rejects today's mundane and over-standardized car experience.   We challenge the 40-year status-quo in automotive design, and bring aesthetic, simplicity and color back to the cars.

launches.body:
Hi everyone! We are Daniel, Felix, and Samuel, and we are building Cellbyte.

**TL;DR:** [Cellbyte](https://cellbyte.com)’s AI agents help pharma companies launch new drugs worldwide. Market-leading firms are using Cellbyte to answer questions like “What price can we achieve for our new drug in the U.S. versus Germany?“.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83038&key=user_uploads/820521/da2f6118-b254-4f9c-bc07-97db95767dc6)


# **Problem:**

Most medicines being launched are missing their revenue potential by a large margin due to messy pharma data causing expensive inefficiencies. When preparing a drug launch, pharmaceutical manufacturers have to choose between three options:

* **Manual research:** time-consuming, human errors, language barriers
* **Databases:** $300k / year, poor data quality, limited scope
* **Consulting:** $300k / project, answers in weeks, data snapshots

# **Solution:**

* Cellbyte consists of 3 main layers:
  * **High-quality data:** comprehensive, globally interconnected, up-to-date
  * **Analytics:** instant due to integrated databases, personalized to each user
  * **Workflows:** built on deep user understanding, human-in-the-loop-interactions, consulting-level outputs
* Cellbyte’s AI workforce replaces Legacy Providers
* We’re live in **12 key markets,** adding new ones every week

# **Who we are:**

The three co-founders have known and worked with each other for many years: Daniel brings 5+ years of industry experience from his previous job at leading global Life Sciences consultancy Simon-Kucher. Felix has sold $3m+ ACV enterprise deals to customers like H&M for his previous YC startup. Samuel holds an MSc in Information Systems from TUM, and has built enterprise AI applications from scratch as ML Engineer at Celonis.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83038&key=user_uploads/820521/9cc5b7f4-b6f4-4f9a-8d67-28bf52a576cb)


# **Asks:**

* **June 2025 - We are fundraising!** Get in touch with Felix (felix.steinbrenner@cellbyte.com) if you are an investor or happen to know someone who might be a good fit.

launches.title: Poko - Onramp aggregator and direct checkout for web3 wallets & marketplaces
launches.tagline: Onramp with 70% lower costs and 6x transaction success rates
launches.body:
Hi all! Geoffrey and Van from [**Poko**](https://Pokoapp.xyz) here! \
\
I (Geoffrey) was at Devcon in Bogota trying to top up my wallet. Used Moonpay - transaction failed. Used Transak - transaction failed. Used Coinbase Pay - transaction failed. Fiat to Crypto onramps [fail anywhere from 30% to 90% of the time around the world](https://www.pokoapp.xyz/post/success-rates-fiat-onramps). We solve this problem through our Onramp Aggregator and Direct Checkout.

**TLDR**

We provide wallets and marketplaces infra providers with an [Onramp Aggregator](https://www.pokoapp.xyz/onramp-aggregator) - a single integration for all localized onramps enabling them to onramp with **local payments,** at up to **6x transaction success rates** and [**70% lower costs** than Moonpay/Transak](https://www.pokoapp.xyz/post/problems-with-onramps-fees). We also provide a [Direct Checkout](https://www.pokoapp.xyz/direct-checkout) on local payment rails for users to pay seamlessly into a smart contract (e.g. for NFT purchasing) without the user needing to onramp. This enables far higher user conversion and transaction success rates. Our payment solutions reach 16M+ active wallets.

**Who is it for**

Our users are wallets, marketplaces, wallet- and marketplace-infra providers, and games/DApps seeking a better payments experience and monetization from their end users. For infrastructure partners, we provide features that serve them especially well (e.g. dashboards and data/flexibility to meet multiple use cases) and a revenue share for them to scale with transaction volume.

# 

# 💵 **How does it work?**

**Onramp Aggregator**\
We route users to onramps with the highest success rates and lowest transaction costs for a particular currency, payment method, and token for Everytime Lowest Prices. We bring onboard onramps focused on a single country as they provide the highest success rates. This is because localized onramps provide rates, payment methods, and KYC processes that work best for their market. Onramps compete to provide the best rate and highest transaction success. \
\
_Check out a live demo (and live rates) here:_ \
<https://www.pokoapp.xyz/onramp-aggregator>\
_Read the product docs:_\
<https://pokoapp.gitbook.io/documentation/onramp-aggregator/what-is-onramp-aggregator>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71045&key=user_uploads/855612/147e959f-afd1-43fa-9f66-4ff5088da633)

_Live rates with a **1400 basis point difference** between the lowest cost and highest cost onramp (Brazil)!_

**Direct Checkout**\
One-step NFT purchasing using cards and popular payment rails from any wallet or on any marketplace. This enables users to frictionlessly purchase gaming NFTs or other digital goods without onramping (we automate the onramp and swaps and hide this from users). This increases paid user conversion in web3 by 79% as users use the payment rails most available to them and avoid unnecessary friction like KYC or complicated token purchasing and swaps.\
\
_Check out a demo in staging here:_ <https://stg.marketplace.checkout.pokoapp.xyz/>\
_Product documentation:_ \
<https://pokoapp.gitbook.io/documentation/direct-checkout/what-is-direct-checkout>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71045&key=user_uploads/855612/21f3d0f0-3b86-42a1-9133-13a2e1f90175)

**Why we built** [**Pokoapp.xyz**](http://Pokoapp.xyz)\
We believe in giving web3 wallets, marketplaces, and DApps bank-like superpowers by connecting them with local payment rails so that assets can move between tradfi payment rails to crypto rails seamlessly. We believe we are helping builders build the banks of the future - and better ones!\
\
**Our Ask**

Know a wallet, marketplace or DApp needing onramps? **Put us in touch** or better yet, **send them our demo** so that they can see for themselves how much their users can save using our Onramp Aggregator!\
\
**Contact us**\
Reach out via TG (<https://t.me/geoffreysee>), email ([geoffrey@pokoapp.xyz](mailto:geoffrey@pokoapp.xyz)) or schedule something here: <https://www.pokoapp.xyz/onramp-aggregator>

name: AiSupervision
long_description: We make the operating system to track, manage and improve production in factories with many workers. We automate what the best supervisors would do if they watched everything that’s happening inside your factory.
one_liner: The operating system for factory production lines

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
app_answers.answer: Manage production in factories with many humans

app_answers.question: How long have each of you been working on this? How much of that has been full-time? Please explain.
app_answers.answer:
We have started working on this project in September 2020 and originally intended to use computer vision to count pallets produced in these factories. 

We realized this was not feasible because of GDPR and replaced cameras with RFID for counting productivity. We also realized there was a much bigger opportunity to become a platform for managing the entire production process (especially when there are many humans doing the work) and pivoted into the complete production management platform which we sell now.

We worked on it part time (~30 hours per week) from September 2020 to June 2021 and have both been full time since then.

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
We have built a platform to track, manage and improve each step of the industrial production process for factories that are human labour intensive.

We developed touchscreen devices installed at each work area on the factory floor. Workers use RFID tags and touchscreens to create data events for when each unit is produced and when there are downtimes. Factory managers get real-time notifications of downtimes and when productivity is lower than expected so they can quickly act to improve productivity.

Our platform creates structured data around each step of the production process:
* receiving raw materials and completing preparation checklists 
* sending work to a workstation and monitoring its progress
* capturing quality control photographs (with automated AI inspection)
* confirming output counts
* generating invoices 
* clients can log in to view progress and quality control photographs

There are several stakeholders (worker, foreman, manager, external labour company, end client) and each has their own dashboard, automated alerts and data permissions. We create a history of every action taken on an order and enable the stakeholders to communicate in a single place with per-second manhours measurements per unit and detailed downtime data providing context. 

Communication between stakeholders is especially complicated and messy without our platform when the workers in the factory are contracted from an external labour provider as is the case in surprisingly many factories.

We have also developed a novel computer vision inspection system that is currently being piloted to generate per-unit quality metrics and generate a visual audit trail of each unit produced.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CEO of AiSupervision. Industrial engineer and hater of redundant work processes. 15+ years of experience working in factories and on production sites as a project and sales manager.

name: Eventual
long_description:
Every breakthrough AI application, from foundation models to autonomous vehicles, relies on processing massive volumes of images, video, and complex data. But today’s data platforms (like Databricks and Snowflake) are built on top of tools made for spreadsheet-like analytics, not the petabytes of multimodal data that power AI. As a result, teams waste months on brittle infrastructure instead of conducting research and building their core product.

Eventual was founded in 2022 to solve this. Our mission is to make querying any kind of data, images, video, audio, text, as intuitive as working with tables, and powerful enough to scale to production workloads. Our open-source engine, Daft, is purpose-built for real-world AI systems: coordinating with external APIs, managing GPU clusters, and handling failures that traditional engines can’t. Daft already powers critical workloads at companies like Amazon, Mobileye, Together AI, and CloudKitchens.

We’ve assembled a world-class team from Databricks, AWS, Nvidia, Pinecone, GitHub Copilot, Tesla, and more, quadrupling our size within a year. With backing from Y Combinator, Caffeinated Capital, Array.vc, and top angels from the co-founders of Databricks and Perplexity, we’re looking to double the team now. Join us—Eventual is just getting started.

Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our San Francisco office in the Mission district 4 days / week.
one_liner: Building the AI data engine for any modality and scale

name: Massdriver
long_description:
Massdriver is an internal developer platform and platform orchestrator. Platform teams publish the Terraform, OpenTofu, and Helm they already write to a catalog; developers and AI agents provision from it with policy enforced before every deploy. Self-hosted or managed.

Platform teams encode their security, compliance, and cost requirements into the modules once. Developers and AI agents pick from the catalog, policy runs before anything is created, and every deploy is recorded with who proposed and who approved it.

Massdriver generates an ephemeral pipeline per deploy, so there are no standing CI/CD pipelines to maintain. Run it self-hosted, on-prem, or in your cloud.

launches.title: 🧑‍🚀 Massdriver - Production-ready cloud infrastructure in minutes
launches.tagline: Massdriver handles the boring parts of cloud infrastructure management and DevOps so your team can focus on building great products.
launches.body:
**tl;dr Engineers spend 20-30% of their time reading cloud documentation and fidgeting with tools like Terraform or doing 'ClickOps.' With Massdriver, engineers can provision secure, production-ready cloud infrastructure in minutes without cloud expertise using a simple diagramming interface.**

Hey all, we’re Cory, Chris, and David, the team behind [Massdriver.](https://massdriver.cloud) We’re on a mission to radically simplify cloud infrastructure management and ‘DevOps.’

## 😢 The Problem

For many organizations, DevOps is no longer a set of practices and culture. It’s a separate team with its own backlog slowing down your product development. Software today isn’t simply code on a computer. It’s a series of ~~tubes~~ APIs and services stitched together with YAML, tools like Terraform, and complex IAM rules. A bunch of boring plumbing that is slowing down your feature velocity.

## 🪄 Our Solution

Massdriver is a visual development platform that lets engineers focus on what services they need from the cloud and easily connect them without worrying about implementation details. Massdriver takes care of secret management, provisioning, parity, best practices, and IAM so your team can focus on your product. Our infrastructure and application bundles are open source, so you can modify them as your organization evolves or create your own and extend the platform.

## ⚙ How It Works

Developers can quickly connect dozens of pre-built infrastructure and application bundles designed by industry experts to provision secure production-ready infrastructure in minutes. Massdriver focuses on developer needs, not the implementation details of infrastructure, making it easy for developers of any caliber to get great infrastructure instantly.

Our pre-built infrastructure bundles can be forked and modified, and the community can also design their own bundles using Terraform and Helm to extend the platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=66021&key=user_uploads/920899/fea74a72-ac18-49a6-bdc5-f8e8af425525)

## 🚀 Out of This World Features

* Parity management with replication support for infrastructure and applications between regions, environments, and cloud accounts
* Integrated secret management that injects credentials directly into your applications environment variables
* Automated principle of least privilege for IAM
* Dozens of best-practice reference architecture infrastructure bundles to get started, each open-sourced and designed by industry experts
* Compliance and security scanning for official infrastructure bundles
* Activity and audit logs of every change to ease your path to compliance
* Visually compare differences between environments like staging and production or between deployments
* Integrated alerting and monitoring
* Application support for containerized and serverless workloads
* Enterprise-ready deployments for SaaS products - your product in your customer's cloud account today.

## 🙏 Asks

Try it out! Feel free to register on the site and try it out; no credit card is required. If you like it, we have a _stellar_ [deal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/deals/1318?query=mass) for all YC companies.

Join us on [GitHub](https://github.com/massdriver-cloud/docs/discussions/9), or DM us on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/massdriver)!

If you have 10 minutes to chat about Massdriver, please book a time with me [here](https://calendly.com/coryodaniel/10min-intro) 😊

name: Mindbase
long_description:
Mindbase is an AI avatar platform where we launch AI avatars of real human as well create artificial entities and grow them on Instagram/Youtube like a influencer using AI content strategies. 

We give each AI influencer its own email, phone number and WhatsApp account so they can build deep relationships like a human creator would. 

Already, generating over 5m+ daily views with just a network of 10+ AI influencers.

Our business model is simple: brands pay us between $1,000 to $4,000 per month per AI influencer. One of our brand partners generated $45,000 in sales from a $3,000 spend, achieving a 15X ROAS.

We believe this is just the beginning.  We can generate $20,000 annually per AI influencer. With just 5000 AI influencers we can quickly scale to $100 million ARR business. 

To put that in perspective: there are over 400 million regular human influencers globally. Even if we just target a fraction of the market, it’s a massive thing.

Our team is the key to making this happen. We're alumni of IIT and repeat founders. Previously, built TradeX, a prediction market platform, scaled that to $40 million in monthly trading volume with 5 million users. That success was driven by our trend tracking system & influencer partnerships, the very same expertise we're now using to build Mindbase.
one_liner: Build AI influencers that autonomously create content, engage fans…

name: BBy
long_description: BBy's condensing device turns milk into a fine powder that spares the biome leaving it biologically and immunologically active. This allows  hospitals to stop wasting precious nursing time defrosting milk for hours and milk wastage from discarding rules. Simply weigh the powder, add water, shake and serve. No more freezing, no more defrosting, only patient care. NICUs are time sensitive wards in the hospital, time is everything and yet nurses today continue to prepare frozen milk for infants in what's known as the milk shift. A shift where the nurse spends the day defrosting milk for the next shift of nurses. Our tech is now fully peer reviewed and published, yielding safe and reliable results in over 20 hospitals in the New York Tri-State. The company is headed by Vansh Langer MD, a physician (Windsor University, University of Chicago) and Blanca Aguilar Uscanga PhD, a Bioengineering/Food Science PhD (University of Guadalajara /Centro Universitario de Ciencias Exactas e Ingenierías (CUCEI)) team that has over 50 published works in the field between them and are experts in the science of infant nutrition. Vansh saw the immense need for a time critical solution in the NICU and helped solve the puzzle with Dra. Blanca and her team and decided to work together to: Nurture the Future.
one_liner: BBy powders breast milk that's immunologically active & lasts 6 months
